question: His second line, 2nd player loading saves is all messed up, is not in this build: the p2 save under salvagerun:profile:p2 (netSlotOf and the save key code in the net section) needs its own look, and I did not touch it. Two small calls I made for him to confirm: a gun that is not automatic gets its trigger released for one frame after each round so it keeps shooting at its own rate (otherwise a pistol would fire once and stop on a held trigger), and the row is ON when either window has it on, the same more-help-wins rule as kid mode, so the child window cannot turn it off while the host has it on.
why: His child on player 2 cannot aim a stick and pull a trigger at the same time yet, so he asked for a mode where player 2 shoots at the closest enemy by itself. This adds a Settings row beside Kid mode, AUTO-FIRE FOR PLAYER 2, off out of the box and saved with the profile the same way kid mode is (P.p2Auto), and the host sends its choice in the world word twice a second (m.af) so either window can turn it on and it lands on player 2 mid raid. It acts only in a linked window with NET.role join: every raid frame, before the face is read from the cursor, it finds the nearest enemy inside gun range with a clear line (losClear, the same segments the game uses), puts the cursor on it the way the controller places its virtual cursor (a screen point, so aim, focus aim and the shot all follow), and holds the trigger the way RT does (mouse.down, marked PAD.afire so letting go clears only what it set). A gun that is not automatic gets the trigger released for one frame after each round so the next pull comes at the gun rate the mouse path already enforces. It never fires under the open backpack or map, paused, downed, over, reloading, jammed, cooking a grenade, with no rounds anywhere, with anything but a gun cell up, or at the Peddler, a survivor, a merc, a teammate or a peaceful pillager; player 1 and the host window are never touched.
title: PLAYER 2 SHOOTS BY ITSELF
